Babel.title: Babel
Babel.question: Can human ambition be redirected toward shared blessing instead of self-exaltation?

chapters.title: The Brick
chapters.game: Mix clay and shape a brick for the tower.

chapters.title: The Tower
chapters.game: Stack bricks toward the sky without a plan.

chapters.title: The Summit
chapters.game: Reach the top and name the project after yourself.

chapters.title: The Confusion
chapters.game: Watch the languages scatter as the work stops.

chapters.title: The Scattering
chapters.game: Walk away from the half-built city.
